title: CommandMRO — assessment to readiness, the personalized path back to ready

narration.style: value-first / JTBD, plain-English; throughline 'assessment -> evidence -> readiness -> personalized path back to ready'; spoken full dimension and feature names, never acronyms; close on the personalized path

beats.title: Mission Control
beats.voGist: Open on the dark technical Mission Control: cohort readiness across six capability bars, who needs attention, and how many learner reviews are waiting.

beats.title: Course Builder + advancement rule
beats.voGist: Open the block, then the module, then the assessment settings: per-dimension minimums, the on-fail routing (AI-auto, instructor-approved, or a specific path), and the remedial pool that feeds it.

beats.title: Doctrine + Framework
beats.voGist: Mid-video governance proof point: the controlled source material and the six-capability framework weights, with Safety and Compliance weighted highest.

beats.title: LXP path
beats.voGist: On the learner tablet, the personalized path: what's up next, what's awaiting review, and what's still locked.

beats.title: IMI runner
beats.voGist: Hands-on familiarization in the interactive module: reading the ground power cart output gauges for in-band voltage.

beats.title: VR bridge card
beats.voGist: The assessment-complete bridge card: results sent to CommandIQ. (Do not capture the headset runtime.)

beats.title: Learner session review
beats.voGist: The instructor's learner session review: the per-dimension breakdown with failing dimensions in red, the audit trail, and the course rollup.

beats.title: Instructor adaptive review
beats.voGist: The hero beat: the AI recommends about three targeted refreshers per failed dimension; the instructor curates or overrides. The AI recommends, the instructor approves.

beats.title: Back to LXP
beats.voGist: The payoff: back on the learner's personalized path, the newly-assigned refreshers are now waiting up next.
